text:
olivia: Heads-up: benchmark blog + mini-launch tomorrow. Need press window confirmation and one-line CEO intro. Embargo 07:30 PT.
kate: Confirmed. Press pack uploaded: https://redwood.docs/press/bench-micro.zip. Removed the absolute percentile claim per legal note.
ryan: Syndication list ready. Do we want to tier outreach (top-tier first)?
pressbot: Outreach scheduled: 07:35 PT to tier-1, 07:40 PT to tier-2.
sam: Livestream check: primary RTMP green, fallback on zoom ready. I'll monitor 07:20-08:10 PT.
legal_bot: Legal: cannot share raw benchmark runs; redacted summary CSVs OK after NDA. Also flagged one chart caption; updated in pack.
kate: Draft one-liner for CEO: "Today we publish an updated inference benchmark and tools to help teams reduce latency and cost." Thoughts?
olivia: Good start. Remove "reduce" -> use "balance" to avoid implying guaranteed savings. Also add: "See methodology for details."
ryan: Social schedule suggestion: 07:30 PT blog live, 07:36 PT CEO quote, 08:00 PT explainer clip. I'll queue.
pressbot: Embargo metadata: `embargo: 2026-06-08T14:30:00Z`
olivia: Who owns press DMs first hour?
kate: I'll triage DMs. Route any raw data asks to legal_bot.
sam: I'll post a 10-min ops status in #eng-oncall.
olivia: Please react with :thumbsup: if you own an item.
ryan: :thumbsup:
kate: :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
pressbot: Reminders set for 07:20 PT and 07:50 PT.
olivia: Thanks team—keep updates in this thread if anything changes.
